question: In a certain code language, 'ORBIT' is written as 'SHAQN' and 'PLANT' is written as 'SMZKO'. How will 'PLUTO' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'ORBIT' is written as 'SHAQN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c48e75781c322da42741b783150c2b7406b0059a864adf36282f9d895c601870.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fbb17e9206002c5745d7ab3cf0188bc2a810bbd5d719a44d506dd28633b630d.png] 

And,

'PLANT' is written as 'SMZKO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78eeb910794d40cbd9acb32cadb412874ac1bbd03a0384971977a1360893fc32.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc12cf213e89de45526571b5da8d3c6575f284a2ced98834e2a62f3d296a6f67.png] 

Similarly,

'PLUTO' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adb808f6ec4f8eb7635630a84d0057ae650b2eedc33a080fdbd99d44861f276c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2dbeab8b1da50f249550ed0c3a5984bccf993ac45c0cd1762113c9ea6350c86.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
